claims: Dan Hurley is the head coach of the UConn men's basketball team.
Dan Hurley has led the Huskies since 2018.
Dan Hurley guided the UConn men's basketball team to NCAA championships in 2023 and 2024.
Dan Hurley was named the 14th head coach in UConn program history in 2018.
Dan Hurley led UConn to NCAA championships in 2023 and 2024.
Dan Hurley is the 2024 Naismith College Coach of the Year.
Dan Hurley is the 2024 BIG EAST Coach of the Year.
Dan Hurley coached at Rhode Island before joining UConn.
Dan Hurley coached at Wagner before joining UConn.
Dan Hurley is the son of Hall of Fame coach Bob Hurley Sr.
Dan Hurley is the brother of former Duke star Bobby Hurley.
Dan Hurley is head coach of the UConn 2025-26 coaching staff.
Kimani Young is associate head coach of the UConn 2025-26 coaching staff.
Mike Nardi is assistant coach of the UConn 2025-26 coaching staff.
Luke Murray left in March 2026 to become the head coach at Boston College.
